## Endpoints

### Data Read (11)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve details for a specific item by its ID.
- `GET /{id}/{149e9513-01fa-4fb0-aad4-566afd725d1bId}/mfc` — Retrieve MFC data for a specific item.
- `GET /assets/{assetJwt}` — Download an asset using a JWT.
- `GET /captcha/v1/{v1Id}/static/{staticId}/zh.json` — Download a Chinese language captcha resource.
- `GET /epic-store/static/webpack/{webpackId}` — Download a webpack resource.
- `GET /r/c/-110187192/x/px/{pxId}` — Retrieve a pixel tracking resource.
- `GET /v1/ad-events/firstquartile/{firstquartileId}` — Report an ad first quartile event.
- `GET /v1/ad-events/midpoint/{midpointId}` — Report an ad midpoint event.
- `GET /v1/ad-events/start/{startId}` — Report an ad start event.
- `GET /v1/ad-events/thirdquartile/{thirdquartileId}` — Report an ad third quartile event.
- `POST /api/v2/public/egs/gifting/offers/giftable` — Check if a user can gift a specific offer.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /{id}` — Create or update an item with a specific ID.
- `POST /{id}/{149e9513-01fa-4fb0-aad4-566afd725d1bId}/tl` — Post data to a timeline endpoint.
- `POST /r/tn/eu/twitchcsmevent` — Post data to a Twitch CS event endpoint.

### Media (1)
- `GET /api/v2/channel/hls/guanweiboy.m3u8` — Retrieve an HLS media playlist.

### Config (2)
- `GET /config/manifest.json` — Download the application manifest configuration.
- `GET /eppo/api/flag-config/v1/config` — Fetch feature flag configurations.
